name: cypress-cloud-migration-skill
description: Migrate test automation from Cypress Cloud to TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest) in any language or framework. Covers cypress run --record --key, projectId, --parallel/--group/--ci-build-id orchestration, cypress- io/github-action record mode, Cypress Cloud Test Replay and analytics. Use this whenever someone wants to move, switch, port, migrate or point tests from Cypress Cloud to TestMu AI or LambdaTest, asks what the TestMu or LT:Options equivalent is for a capability, config, CLI flag or API from Cypress Cloud, mentions cypress run --record, CYPRESS_RECORD_KEY, projectId in cypress.config, --parallel, --group, --ci-build-id, cypress-io/github- action record: true, Cypress Dashboard, or wants a migration plan, estimate, PR or checklist for a repo currently on Cypress Cloud, even without the word migrate.
